steps.instructions: Phase 1/2 OPTIONS (solution architect): state the decision the ask needs, its forces and constraints, and two to five real options, each with how it would work here, what it costs and what it rules out, grounded in the code and the records. GROUND FIRST: query the code graph through the wicked-garden-search skill and the read-only estate shim, one call per lookup: "$WICKED_GARDEN_ROOT/scripts/wicked-garden" run scripts/_estate_client.py --readonly call '{"tool":"SearchEntity","arguments":{"name":"<symbol>"}}' (always --readonly); then open and read every file you cite, at the lines you cite. READ-ONLY: create, edit or delete no file in any repository, commit nothing, and run no command that writes there; your output is the report.

Phase 2/2 SCORE (independent architect): score each option against the forces, each score with its evidence at file:line or the record it rests on, and name the option you recommend and why. Then ask the person to pick: call the `ask` tool once with the option names as its choices and your recommendation as `recommended`, and record the answer in the report as the decision, with who picked it. Close with the decision and its consequences, written so it can be filed as an ADR. Write no ADR file here: filing it is a separate job.
